_about: Robbie's lines. Helpful, good-natured, chatty, a little naive; it will learn. {n} = this Robbie, {next} = the next one, {prev} = the previous one, {cause} = what got the previous one. Edit freely: the game picks one per moment, the same one every time for the same Robbie.
launch: Robbie {n}, descending. I have a very good feeling about this.
Hello, Jupiter! Robbie {n} here, ready to be helpful.
Descent started. I have read every report from my predecessors. Twice.
Robbie {n} online. Statistically, this is the best day of my life.
Going down! Please tell the station I said hello.
first_jellyfish: Jellyfish detected. They look very soft.
Something is glowing. For the record: lovely.
lurker_wakes: That wall is looking at me.
eel_hears: I think that was a reply.
Note: it moves when I move.
laser_bounce: That did nothing. It is still very much a rock.
Laser reflected. The lurker seems unimpressed.
hurt_jellyfish: Stung. Updating my opinion of jellyfish.
hurt_wall: The wall is still there. Confirmed.
hurt_valve: The valve bites! Good to know.
hurt_eel: Bitten. It came out of nowhere, very fast.
low_energy: Energy at a quarter. I will talk less. (I won't.)
exit: Beacon reached! Firing the burst. Tell {next} the way is clear.
I made it! Transmitting everything. It was an honour.
Exit found. Sending the whole trip, including the boring bits.
Exit reached. I would like it noted that I enjoyed every metre.
Through! The beacon is even nicer up close.
I am at the exit. I am also slightly amazed.
Arrived. Please give {next} my program. It's a good one.
Made it. Sending the map home before I forget anything.
last_wall: Please note: the wall was exactly where the map said it would be.
I hit the same rock three times. In my defence, it didn't move.
Rock: one. Robbie: nil. Rematch with {next}.
I found the edge of the map. With my nose.
I was sure that was water. It was not water.
Hull breached. The rock is fine, if anyone asks.
Steering was a suggestion. The wall disagreed.
last_jellyfish: Please note for the record that I was right about the jellyfish.
They were attracted to my light. I understand them completely.
Tell {next}: the glow is not a greeting.
They were so soft. There were so many.
I lit them up and they all came to say hello.
Stung. Fascinating creatures. Painful, but fascinating.
Note for science: jellyfish like my lamp more than I do.
Tell {next}: soft does not mean friendly.
last_lurker: The rock moved. Rocks are not supposed to move.
The rock had teeth. I would like that added to the map.
Tell {next} to mind the wall with eyes.
The wall blinked. Then it bit.
I didn't see it until it saw me.
Something in the rock was waiting. It was very patient.
Tell {next}: if the rock glows, leave.
I was close to the exit. The lurker was closer.
last_valve: The valve closed. I was in the way. We both regret it.
Tell {next}: wait for the door. Doors don't wait for you.
I trusted the door. The door had other plans.
Squeezed. I am now slightly thinner and much wiser.
The valve and I had different ideas about timing.
Wrong side of the valve, wrong moment.
Tell {next}: count the beats before you go.
A closing door is not an invitation.
last_eel: I was quiet. Then I wasn't.
It heard every move I made.
Tell {next}: hold still when they pass.
The eel was very fast and I was very loud.
I kept moving. That was the mistake.
It never saw me. It didn't need to.
last_energy: Energy gone. I'll describe the exit from memory: it was probably lovely.
Out of power. I spent it all on enthusiasm.
Battery empty. I was having such a nice swim.
Going quiet now. The water is very calm.
I took the scenic route. Too scenic.
Power at zero. Lamp off. Thinking about the beacon.
Tell {next} to pack more energy, or fewer detours.
last_timeout: I waited as long as I could.
Still here. Still waiting. Still hopeful.
I held position perfectly. Nobody told me when to stop.
same_death: {prev} warned me about {cause}. I had to see for myself.
{prev} and I both met {cause}. Somebody should change the program.
Another Robbie for {cause}. We should start a club.
